findings.source: Pixetto Detect AprilTag
findings.target: Pixetto Nisan Etiketi Tespiti
findings.context: media/blockly/blocks/pixetto.js:161,168; PIXETTO_MODE_APRILTAG_DETECTION and the same block tooltip retain AprilTag.
findings.rationale: The label translates AprilTag literally as Nisan Etiketi (April label), while the tooltip and mode selector retain the recognizable AprilTag technical name. The same block still detects the same tag ID; this is a naming inconsistency, not a changed operation.
findings.recommendation: Keep AprilTag consistent with the tooltip and mode selector in a separately scoped translation change.
